# 配置参考

框架的默认配置。用例项目在 `conf/config.yaml` 里只写要改的键，按环境叠加写在 `conf/<env>.yaml`（`ipandora run -e <env>`），见 [配置、环境与测试数据](../guide/config.md)。

## `http`

Transport reliability. verify defaults to true -- only turn it off for a specific throwaway environment, and never repo-wide.

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `http.connect_timeout` | `10` | seconds to establish a connection |
| `http.read_timeout` | `30` | seconds to wait for a response; every request is bounded |
| `http.verify` | `true` | TLS certificate verification |
| `http.max_retries` | `2` | idempotent methods only (GET/HEAD/PUT/DELETE/OPTIONS/TRACE) |
| `http.backoff_factor` | `0.3` | seconds; retry n waits backoff_factor * 2^(n-1) |
| `http.pool_maxsize` | `10` | connections kept per host |

## `web`

Web (pip install intellipandora[web]). Defaults for pytest-playwright's own options; a command-line --base-url / --browser, or a suite's conftest, wins.

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `web.base_url` | `null` | e.g. https://staging.example.com, then page.goto('/orders') |
| `web.browser` | `null` | chromium \| firefox \| webkit; default chromium |
| `web.viewport` | `null` | e.g. {width: 1280, height: 720}; default Playwright's |
| `web.trace` | `retain-on-failure` | on \| off. A trace holds request headers and bodies -- tokens and cookies -- unmasked |

## `faults`

Fault injection through Toxiproxy (core/faults.py). Off unless an environment turns it on in its conf/<env>.yaml -- local and CI only; never in prod.

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `faults.allowed` | `false` |  |
| `faults.toxiproxy` | `null` | default http://127.0.0.1:8474, or $TOXIPROXY_URL |

## `consistency`

Consistency checks on an operation history (core/consistency.py): elle-cli, a Java 21 tool. Not installed with the package -- see docs/guide/consistency.md.

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `consistency.elle_cli` | `null` | path to elle-cli-0.1.11-standalone.jar, or $ELLE_CLI_JAR |
| `consistency.java` | `null` | a Java 21+ executable; default: $IPANDORA_JAVA, $JAVA_HOME_21_X64, $JAVA_HOME, PATH |
| `consistency.elle_cli_sha256` | `null` | only for a build you admitted yourself; default: the admitted 0.1.11 |

## `ai`

LLM access is OFF by default and stays that way unless explicitly enabled. It is never used at test-execution time -- only post-run (triage, report summaries). See docs/design/decisions/03-LLM接入边界.md. Requires the optional extra: pip install intellipandora[ai]

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `ai.enabled` | `false` | nothing calls an LLM unless this is true |
| `ai.provider` | `mock` | mock \| anthropic |
| `ai.api_key` | `null` | put it in conf/<env>.yaml that is not committed, never here |
| `ai.model` | `claude-sonnet-5` |  |
| `ai.base_url` | `null` | a gateway in front of the provider, if any |
| `ai.timeout` | `30` | seconds per call |
| `ai.max_tokens` | `1024` | per call |
| `ai.max_calls_per_run` | `20` | a hard cap: 0 means no calls at all |

## `mcp`

The MCP server behind `ipandora mcp` (pip install intellipandora[mcp]).

| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `mcp.enabled` | `true` |  |
| `mcp.name` | `intellipandora` | the server name an agent sees |
| `mcp.transport` | `stdio` | stdio \| sse \| streamable-http |
